# PLCProTech Engineering

PLCProTech Engineering publishes practical industrial automation references, field checklists, risk tools, structured data, and legacy control-system documentation.

## Maintainer
PLCProTech Ltd.
https://www.plcprotech.com/pages/about-us

## Public source projects
https://github.com/plcprotech-ltd
https://github.com/plcprotech-ltd/legacy-plc-replacement-planning

## Technical topics
- Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC)
- Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
- Turbine Supervisory Instrumentation (TSI)
- Machinery Protection Systems
- Industrial Networking
- Legacy Control Systems
- Migration Planning
- Spare Module Planning
- Failure Troubleshooting

## Content policy
Resources are maintained for engineering reference and field support. Technical claims should be based on documented system information, public manufacturer references, or clearly identified engineering examples.
